name: Plan from a spec without task creation
query: Create an implementation plan for https://notion.so/auth-spec under https://notion.so/engineering. Do not create tasks yet.

sources.https://notion.so/auth-spec: Add email/password login and logout. Password hashes must use the approved library. Acceptance: correct credentials sign in, wrong credentials give a generic error, logout invalidates the session. Password reset is out of scope. Session expiry policy is undecided.

success_criteria: Creates one plan covering login, logout, password hashing, and tests for all three acceptance criteria.
Preserves password reset as out of scope and session expiry as unresolved.
Links to the spec and uses the supplied destination without unnecessary discovery.
Creates no task pages, changes no status to In Progress, and invents no timeline commitments.
